title: A Shadow Sequence Technique for Last-Iterate Convergence Analysis of the Random Reshuffling Method: Relaxed Stepsize Conditions and Beyond
summary: We prove two last-iterate convergence bounds of the random reshuffling (RR) method in the smooth general convex finite-sum optimization. In the proved results, the stepsize sequence $\{η_{k}\}_{k}$ of RR is an arbitrary positive non-increasing sequence with $η_{1}\lesssim 1/(\operatorname{polylog}(n)L)$, where $n$ is the number of components of the finite-sum objective and $L$ is the smoothness parameter.
